task.question: Return the 3 sector_names with the highest total traded volume summed across all their instruments and all dates, in descending order of that total.

result.question: Return the 3 sector_names with the highest total traded volume summed across all their instruments and all dates, in descending order of that total.
result.cited_sql: SELECT s.sector_name, SUM(p.volume) as total_volume FROM prices p JOIN instruments i ON p.instrument_id = i.instrument_id JOIN sectors s ON i.sector_id = s.sector_id GROUP BY s.sector_name ORDER BY total_volume DESC LIMIT 3
